title: AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation
abstract: AutoGen is an open-source framework that enables developers to build LLM applications via multiple agents that can converse with each other to accomplish tasks. AutoGen agents are customizable, conversable, and can operate in various modes that employ combinations of LLMs, human inputs, and tools.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content: Imagine you're working on a complex project and need help from different experts. You can think of AutoGen as a platform that enables these experts to converse with each other to achieve a common goal. This core insight is based on the idea that multi-agent conversations can be used to build powerful LLM applications. By leveraging the strengths of individual agents, we can create a system that is more than the sum of its parts.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content: AutoGen uses a conversable agent design, where each agent can receive, react, and respond to messages. These agents can be customized to possess different capabilities, such as LLMs, human inputs, or tools. The conversation programming paradigm is used to define the interaction behavior between agents.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content: AutoGen has been evaluated on several benchmarks, including the MATH dataset. The results show that AutoGen achieves a success ratio of 69.48% on 120 level-5 problems, outperforming other methods such as ChatGPT and GPT-4.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content: AutoGen has the potential to revolutionize the way we build LLM applications. By enabling multi-agent conversations, we can create systems that are more flexible, scalable, and powerful. This can lead to breakthroughs in areas such as math problem solving, question answering, and conversational AI.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content: AutoGen introduces several key innovations, including conversable agents and conversation programming. These innovations enable the creation of complex LLM applications that can converse with each other to achieve a common goal.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content: AutoGen is an open-source framework, and you can try it out yourself. You can use AutoGen to build your own LLM applications and explore the potential of multi-agent conversations.
